import re

def parse_nginx_access_log(line: str) -> dict:
    """
    Parse a standard nginx access log line into a dictionary.
    
    Expected format (combined log format):
    IP - - [timestamp] "METHOD /path HTTP/version" status bytes "referer" "user-agent"
    
    Example:
    127.0.0.1 - - [10/Oct/2023:13:55:36 +0000] "GET /index.html HTTP/1.1" 200 2326 "-" "Mozilla/5.0"
    """
    # Regex pattern for combined log format
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'(?P<ip>\S+)\s+'          # IP address
        r'(?P<ident>\S+)\s+'       # ident (usually -)
        r'(?P<user>\S+)\s+'        # user (usually -)
        r'\[(?P<timestamp>[^\]]+)\]\s+'  # timestamp in brackets
        r'"(?P<request>[^"]*)"\s+'  # request line in quotes
        r'(?P<status>\d{3})\s+'    # status code
        r'(?P<bytes>\d+|-)\s+'     # bytes sent (or -)
        r'"(?P<referer>[^"]*)"\s+' # referer in quotes
        r'"(?P<user_agent>[^"]*)"' # user agent in quotes
    )
    
    match = pattern.match(line.strip())
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Log line does not match expected nginx access log format: {line}")
